{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D21","page":1,"quote":"20±0.02"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"Dimension D21 specifies a tight tolerance of ±0.02 mm on a part that receives I.Z.B.P. plating, but the drawing does not state whether the plated or unplated size is intended. Plating adds thickness that can push this feature out of tolerance and prevent proper assembly; the designer must clarify if the dimension applies before or after plating and adjust limits accordingly."
  , "recommended_correction": "Add a note specifying whether D21 is a pre-plating or post-plating dimension, and adjust the tolerance to account for the expected plating thickness."}]}
